# `aitbc confidential send`

Send a confidential amount from a wallet to a recipient.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc confidential send [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet-id` | text | — | yes | Wallet ID. |
| `--recipient-id` | text | — | yes | Recipient ID. |
| `--amount` | text | — | yes | Amount of AIT. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc confidential send --wallet-id <wallet_id> --recipient-id <recipient_id> --amount <amount>
```
